facts.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

setpoint.label: re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The proving zero energy before intrusive work must be provided, and its effectiveness must be recorded as a critical control verification before the task proceeds. The re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation must be set at 8 hours. This clause applies to activities archived under ISOLATION-OF-STORED-ENERGY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
